BiblicalUsage: Addon is one of the towns named in the lists of exiles who came back from Babylon — families returning to a land their grandparents had lost. In Ezra's list the name is spelled Addan; the place itself is covered in the Biblical Places collection.
TheologicalSignificance: There is no doctrine tucked inside this place-name, and I won't invent one. What it does show is how carefully the returning exiles guarded who belonged where — lineage mattered to them, and the record kept the question open rather than guessing.
